notes: Tables 1-4 (SLM parameters, texture parameter, tensile comparison, EDS of fracture-surface particles) are not in the packet; TP values and Nb-rich particle composition are kept in image_note/requires_unseen. Residual stress/dislocation density (n11) has no measurement in the figures and is argued from layer counting. Audit a1: cube texture (F6c/d) makes the punch axis <100> in both discs, which weakens the crystallographic part of the Schmid-factor argument (m1). Audit a2: the 650 C 'top better' ranking rests on a ~6% difference with nearly overlapping error bars. Packet: paper Fig. 10 is absent; packet F10/F11 are paper Figs. 11/12; F9/F10 tier C3 'caption_swap' although images and captions agree; F1b cue class 'micrograph' is false (it is a load-displacement curve); F5b legend lies in the F5c crop.
